title: Moving the sine wave by mentally humming a tone
place_text: Undisclosed facility near the NSA complex, Maryland

tellings.quote: looking at the box. When I saw the the the sine wave move, it it is like it came into focus.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, hired him to talk to aliens with his mind, tells of training in the early 1990s at a facility near the NSA complex in Maryland. He says he had to mentally hum a tone while watching a wavy line, a sine wave, on a box, and that when he saw the line move it all came into focus. He tells the story in his book Above Black, and if true it would mean the government trained people in telepathic communication.
